messages:
tobias_dev: Hey CS — integrating Redwood SDK into Garnet client. During a controlled ramp (80 browser clients) we started seeing 429s ~30s into the test. No other errors. Anyone seen this pattern with short-lived tokens?

maya_cs: @tobias_dev thanks for flagging. Can you paste the Authorization header + token TTL and whether you do a preflight per tab/process? Also which SDK version?

tobias_dev: sure — headers: Authorization: Bearer <ephemeral>, X-SDK-Version: 0.9.1, X-Client-App: garnet-web. Token TTL configured to 60s, refresh every 45s. We do a preflight on each tab open (so multiple parallel workers). Logs show `rate_limited` with message: "preflight concurrency limit".

sam_engineer: 60s TTL + many parallel preflights will hit our edge windows quickly. Two common things to check: 1) are you doing a preflight file-per-request or a single client auth per page? 2) are refreshes synchronized across workers (stampede)?

jorge_support: additional note: there is a separate soft limit on `/v1/preflight` endpoints to protect handshake throughput. If you refresh tokens per-request you multiply windows. Workarounds: reuse session token across tabs, increase TTL during onboarding, or add splay to refreshes.

tobias_dev: aha — we create a fresh ephemeral on every worker. Changing to shared pool now. Quick snippet of what we had: 
```js
// naive per-worker refresh (bad)
async function init() {
  const t = await fetch('/auth/ephemeral')
  window.TOKEN = await t.text()
}

// 12 tabs -> 12 preflights in <100ms
```

sam_engineer: exact repro. If you can, try this pattern instead: single refresh per browser session + in-memory TTL pool. Also set token TTL to >=300s for the initial ramp (or coordinate refresh offsets). Example: `refreshInterval = Math.max( ttl * 0.6, 10000 + Math.random()*200 )`

maya_cs: short-term mitigation I recommend: 1) increase TTL to 5m for the onboarding run, 2) add jittered stagger on start (200-500ms), 3) change SDK to reuse token across tabs, 4) enable exponential backoff on 429s with cap 2s. I can open a temporary rate allowance if you need to load test quickly.

deploy-bot: sdkgateway v2.3.1 deployed to edge (rolled at 6090123600) :rocket:

tobias_dev: thanks — implementing shared pool + bump TTL now. Will run another ramp in ~20m and post logs. Appreciate the quick tips.

maya_cs: ping us if it doesn’t improve. If it still fails, we’ll collect auth traces and escalate to infra for a temporary onboarding burst window. :thumbsup:

jorge_support: also check that you’re not rotating API keys during the ramp — rotating generates new key identifiers in the edge cache and can cause extra lookups. Keep the same key for the test.

tobias_dev: noted. will keep key stable and report back with results + logs in thread. Thanks everyone!
